propositions: bridge_fsck reads prev_snapshot.json off disk and uses field values for drift classification, so narrowing prev to a key-set would silently degrade classifications
bridge_fsck passes jira_snapshot[key] fields into ObservedJira.PRESENT but does not consume ctx.prev_snapshot, making it an out-of-band consumer undetected by reconcile_once tests
key-set prev fixtures with empty dicts ({jira_key: {}}) cause false drift classifications because field-dependent logic treats absent fields as absent values instead of indeterminate
bridge_fsck must report terminal-local status checks as indeterminate rather than false would_terminal when field values are required but absent from key-set snapshots
full-payload prev behavior must remain byte-identical to current behavior and CLI exit codes and JSON shape must not change
